description: Talon and her allies confront the Masters and the origins of the kinjes as rival rulers, old loyalties and the fate of the Blackbloods converge on a final battle for the Outpost.

s04e01.description: Garret urges Talon to claim the throne while an assassin seeks revenge, Falista devises a new plan and Zed uncovers a secret about Wren while pushing her toward leadership.

s04e02.description: Garret attacks a new queen, strange visions warn of a larger threat and Talon and Zed plan a rescue of the Blackbloods while Janzo discovers Wren's secret.

s04e03.description: Garret is freed but forced to serve a new ruler as Talon and Zed return to save the Blackbloods and Falista attempts an uneasy peace.

s04e04.description: Garret leads a rebellion while Talon and Zed track a Lu Qiri to a new enemy, and Falista draws Wren and Janzo into a plan of her own.

s04e05.description: Talon and Luna fight to save Zed from supernatural forces while Garret pressures Tobin to betray Falista and Wren and Janzo explore what lies beneath the Outpost.

s04e06.description: Garret and Luna undertake a rescue mission, Tobin proves where his loyalty lies and discoveries beneath the Outpost lead into a search for Luna's origins.

s04e07.description: Talon and Luna recruit an old ally to find an ancient key while Wren and Janzo accidentally unleash a new menace and Garret and Zed go hunting.

s04e08.description: Talon and Luna challenge the gods with mixed results, Janzo is reunited with someone from his past and Garret and Janzo clash over a prisoner's fate.

s04e09.description: Talon and Zed experience ominous visions beneath the Outpost, Garret tests his relationship with Talon and Janzo works to solve an old relic's riddle.

s04e10.description: Talon and Luna return to a familiar tomb while Janzo and Wren face danger and Zed, Munt and Nedra are forced into a deadly game against the gods.

s04e11.description: Talon and Luna face an agonising choice while Zed returns to the Outpost carrying a heavy burden.

s04e12.description: Talon and Luna return with an unreliable ally as Garret and Zed move against the Outpost, Janzo and Wren race to save the Kahvi and Aster's real plan comes into focus.

s04e13.description: Talon and her allies make their final stand against the gods while Janzo, Wren and Munt fight to save the Kahvi and a new ruler emerges.
